text:
I fixed the failures I found by reading the code, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so please run it to confirm everything passes.

Fixes in `catalog/`:
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma`, so it returns all three titles.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by the daily rate instead of adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events instead of `n+1`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text` instead of the non-existent `catalog.nonexistent`.

I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
